Q: Is this possible? a new AI age language， easy as py, fast as C++, more secure than Rust A:

My view is the most effective AI programming language will ultimately be "The Requirements Document." Abstract the programming language out of picture entirely. Write the requirements, fire up the AI, test and profile the result, make alterations to the requirements. Rinse. Repeat.

100% replacement of programming languages is a long way out, but the gruntwork code, 80-90% of the code writing, sis a reasonable short term goal.

Q: Stuck sending contact form using WordPress' 'Contact Form 7' plugin A:

In my case, the error was caused because I had a file upload field in my form to upload an attachment, and the file was exceeding the post_max_size and upload_max_filesize (PHP and Apache settings).

When I changed these two, the problem was gone.

Q: You are using an outdated version of Java (11). Java 17 or higher is required A:

I hope this help, 2 step to configure jdk to machine in User Variable and System Variable. And remove the previous software of jdk in the machine.

Q: java.lang.ClassCastException: cannot be cast to com.google.protobuf.Message A:

Ran into this when trying to use pyarrow to access hdfs.. make sure you're using the correct non-deprecated connect method to prevent hadoop version issues

hdfs = fs.HadoopFileSystem('hostname', 8020)

NOT

fs = pa.hdfs.connect('hostname')

Q: How to fixed if it won't run unless I update google play service in android studio A:

In build.gradle (Module:app) I just changed 

compile 'com.google.android.gms:play-services-maps:11.0.4'

to

compile 'com.google.android.gms:play-services-maps:10.0.0'

I tried initially changing to 11.0.0 but experienced the same problem with 11.0.0. so just tried with 10.0.0 and don't have any problems.
